 THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 OF THE CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS FIR, COMPLAINT AND CHARGE SHEET IN C.C.NO.3901/2019 PENDING ON THE FILE OF THE XXXIX A.C.M.M., BENGALURU REGISTERED FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A,506 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SEC.3 AND 4 OF D.P ACT.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This Court on 18.06.2024 had passed a peremptory order, which reads as follows:
"Finally, a week's time is granted to comply with the office objections, failing which,
petition would be dismissed without reference to the Bench."
Even today, there is no representation for the petitioners and the office objections are not complied.
Therefore, the petition is dismissed for its non-prosecution.
Pending I.A. is disposed, as a consequence.
